title: Metamorphoses
author: Various
content:
English-language translations of Metamorphoses include:
Metamorphoses, verse translation by Arthur Golding (1567) (transcription project)
Metamorphoses (1626), by George Sandys
Metamorphoses, verse translation by Samuel Garth, John Dryden, et al. (1727)
The Metamorphoses of Ovid, translation by Henry Thomas Riley (1851)
The Metamorphoses of Publius Ovidius Naso, translated by Henry King (1871)
Metamorphoses, prose translation by Frank Justus Miller (1921) (transcription volumes: 1, 2)
Metamorphoses, prose translation by Wikisource (ongoing)
